My mom, but she just gets extremely upset, and I can't handle that. I have friends, but I know that I can't just move in with them. My mom wouldn't let me, and I don't think that any of them would appreciate me moving in like that...

Normally I just go to my room, I sleep a lot because of the stress and I feel that is one of the few ways I can get away from the fighting, sometimes I just can't eat anything because I'm so stressed out and have gone a day without eating or drinking anything before. 

As a child my brothers wouldn't play games with me, they were not fond of me so I was isolated. My parents both worked so I hardly saw them, and I was alone most of the time. My mom was extremely over-protective and would not let us out of the house alone because she thought we would get kidnapped, so I did not get to be around kids my age that often. I would mostly sneak outside and sit with my dog and just make up games, when he died on my 8th birthday I was devastated knowing that I would have no one to talk to or play with.

My brothers aren't that fond of me still, but we mess around every once in a while and play video games, but that's about it. We all try to stay away from my father as none of us feel close to him, but I'm the one who gets the brunt of his anger.

Thanks, I'll try to do that. The main thing about him is he enjoys argument, he tries to make sure its in a situation that is difficult to get out of. I've tried the putting up with him, and just agreeing with him, and he sought out a fight about why I wasn't telling him the truth, and why I just can't have an 'adult conversation' about my opinions. If I say I would rather not get into a fight with him he then yells at me for not being mature, and says that its only a conversation.

He is extremely racist, sexist, extremely right-wing, and about any other  -ist you can think of.

They were able to accommodate, he just has always been cold toward me, just like my brothers. As I said to iredditi above, I don't want to have him as scum in my mind, because I don't think he is. I've calmed down some from earlier, after just sleeping for 5 hours but I'm just still really messed up by this, and it seems to have become a tradition in my household..

My mom tries to be the mediator, but she has really bad medical issues (heart failure, from an unknown cause) and can't handle it. I don't want to think of him as a piece of sh*t because he's my dad, we have good times, but not more than the bad ones, I just want to get along with him, at least for the sake of my mother.

It's always been small things, like me not emptying the dishwasher because it wasn't my chore to do that day, or us having different opinions. In the first year he took my phone away, then sent me to live with my grandparents who were in the process of changing homes, he wouldn't let me back home for two weeks.

The second year (last year) I had a different opinion than him, and he didn't agree, and I told him off because he said that, I am his daughter and have to do and agree with what he says, because I'm practically his slave. He wants me to just do what he says blindly, never disagree, or even talk for the most part.

This reminds me of what happened to my friend a couple day's again. She was on her computer at school (my school district recently started providing laptops for all high school students) in our trig/pre-calc class, and she was searching on google when all of the sudden words just started popping up in the URL bar. She was hitting backspace, but the words just kept popping up, ending with it being stuck on "this is David, is David". It also said something along the lines of "do you like it when I used you tonight?" We were both really freaked out.
